name: x_rules_multiball_lockout_1
description: rules mode, 2 balls: ball 0 from x_rules_saucer_c4, slot 1 from multi_bounce_upper. EP9-13 keep one sensor lockout per ball (ds:374b+2i, copied into ds:3756 around each ball's pixel scan and decremented per frame per slot); a lockout set by one ball's handler must not block the other ball's sensors. The port with a single lockout diverges at record 37 (collided).
